s2:Probing Thermal Electrons in Gamma-Ray Burst Afterglows

rationale: The candidate paper 2106.04788 investigates the afterglow of GRB 170817A using a model that includes an off-axis top-hat jet, which is relevant to the question regarding the implications of late-time brightening in gamma-ray bursts on jet models.
